text: Hello there, young man.
zh: 你好啊，年轻人。

text: May I help you with something?
zh: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Tell me one of the stories.
zh: 给我讲个故事吧。

text: See you.
zh: 回见。

text: I am the one who cares for the graves here in the capital.
zh: 我是照看王都这些坟墓的人。

text: You may call me #:Mortis:#.
zh: 你可以叫我#:莫尔提斯:#。

text: If you want, I could tell you a few stories about the ones buried here.
zh: 如果你愿意，我可以给你讲讲长眠于此之人的故事。

text: I will be here.
zh: 我会一直在这儿。

text:
With pleasure.
What do you want to know?
zh:
乐意之至。
你想知道什么？

text: Who lies in the tomb?
zh: 陵墓里葬的是谁？

text: Who was Grimbald?
zh: 格林巴尔德是什么人？

text: Who was Sarina?
zh: 萨琳娜是什么人？

text: That's all.
zh: 就这些。

text:
No other than all of our past rulers.
Rumors say, that the first ruler of this capital lies at the lowest floor of the crypt.
zh:
正是我们历代的统治者。
传闻说，这座王都的第一位统治者就长眠在墓穴的最底层。

text: King Weynard II was buried here as well after his and his wife's assassination.
zh: 韦纳德二世国王和王后遇刺之后，他也被安葬在了这里。

text: Queen Miriam, on the other hand, was given a grave outside the capital, near the lake.
zh: 而米里亚姆王后的坟墓则设在王都之外，就在湖边。

text: How did they die?
zh: 他们是怎么死的？

text: Why was the queen buried outside the capital?
zh: 王后为什么葬在王都之外？

text: There's nothing else I want to know.
zh: 我没有别的想问的了。

text: On a faithful night, both of them were killed by an assassin.
zh: 在那个注定的夜晚，他们双双死于刺客之手。

text: No one saw anything until their young son found his parents dead.
zh: 没有人察觉到任何异样，直到他们年幼的儿子发现双亲已经遇害。

text: That poor child was given the crown shortly after. He was not allowed to live his youth anymore.
zh: 那可怜的孩子不久后便戴上了王冠。他再也无法度过属于自己的少年时光。

text: Ever since he was given the position, he rules the kingdom as King Weynard III.
zh: 自登上王位以来，他便以韦纳德三世之名统治着这个王国。

text: Queen Miriam had a special relationship with that lake.
zh: 米里亚姆王后与那片湖有着特殊的情缘。

text: She had many visits to it with her son.
zh: 她生前常常带着儿子去那里。

text: That was the reason King Weynard III had her buried near it.
zh: 正因如此，韦纳德三世才将她安葬在湖边。

text: Is there anything else you want to know?
zh: 你还想知道些什么吗？

text: Come back when you wish for me to tell you a few stories.
zh: 想听我讲故事的时候，就再回来吧。

text: Grimbald was a legendary mage hunter.
zh: 格林巴尔德是一位传奇的法师猎手。

text: He was the one who defeated Rak'Sha in his tower in the wasteland.
zh: 正是他在荒地的高塔中击败了拉克沙。

text: However, the fight took all of his spirit with it, so Grimbald had to settle in the capital.
zh: 然而，那场战斗耗尽了他的心神，格林巴尔德只得在王都定居下来。

text:
He left his legendary sword behind, which ended up bearing his name.
But it remains lost since long ago.
zh:
他留下了那把传奇之剑，后来那把剑便以他的名字命名。
但它早已下落不明。

text:
Or... not?
You really found his sword.
zh:
或者……并非如此？
你竟然真的找到了他的剑。

text: Not much is known about her.
zh: 关于她的事，世人所知不多。

text: Scorion, the Magick Archer, buried her here.
zh: 是秘法射手斯科里昂把她安葬在这里的。

text: It was a bold move, as Scorion was on Grimbalds bounty list.
zh: 这一举动相当大胆，因为斯科里昂正是格林巴尔德悬赏名单上的人物。

text: It is unknown what happened to Scorion, as Grimbald never managed to catch him.
zh: 斯科里昂的下落无人知晓，格林巴尔德始终没能抓到他。
